quests.title: Where the White Dove Rests

dialogue.t: We always used to gather in your garden, Sandrone. Now you're the one visiting me for tea. It's such an odd feeling.
I'm still the one getting everything ready. Doesn't feel so different to me...
Mmhmm, and your food is every bit as delicious as I remember.
Hmm... I hear {NICKNAME} visits you quite often. What do you usually do?
Sometimes we chat, sometimes we play games with the kuuhenki, and we also like to watch them draw. Oh, and we play Moon Chess, too.
Moon Chess? Is that the one where you try to get three pieces in a row? Who usually wins?
I don't keep count, but I must say {NICKNAME}'s a very skilled player.
Heh, I'll show you what real skill looks like. Care for a game? If we draw, it counts as a win for you.
Sure thing. Let's go!
Wh—What? That's impossible!
Looks like you lost, Sandrone.
I... I let you win!
Really? Then why do you seem so worked up?
Darn it... I want a rematch!
Hmph, piece of cake.
You win. You really are quite skilled, Sandrone.
Let's play something more challenging next time. I know a lot of fun math-based games.
Sounds exciting! Hehe.
Huh? What's so funny?
I can barely remember seeing you this happy before. You hardly ever invited me to play games. Usually, you'd just chase me away.
Hey... Don't make me out to be some sort of bully! I'll invite you to more tea parties from now on, alright?
I'd like that, Sandrone. I enjoy these little gatherings.
It's a lot of fun playing games. I look forward to doing it more often.

dialogue.sit: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)
I think it's time I started clearing up.

dialogue.t: Leaving already? Alright, see you next time.

quests.description: Go to Silvermoon Hall, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with Columbina…
